'''Diona''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the ongoing conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], she was stationed on the Republic's [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
